homeScope.status: User-adopted Research Desk A; fresh independent review returned Ship at screenshot scope.
homeScope.selectors: .mc-library[data-research-desk], .mc-library-dialog, .mc-library-detail, and the containing home top bar
homeScope.boundary: Home-specific tokens do not replace shared team/login defaults. Existing API/activity/StatisticsModel and identity/CSRF boundaries remain authoritative.
homeScope.composition: Main/reference lanes retain saved relative order and hidden settings without an exact-default gate. Settings sort within explicit lane groups. Existing cards/list values stay actual cards/comparison; new rows default is A's List mode. No stored preference is cleared or rewritten on read.
homeScope.sparseCards: At >=1800px viewport, frame max1600px. One actual card uses one track capped680px; two use two tracks; phone metadata stretches to the card width. Symmetric44px icon targets, no SVG translations.
homeScope.activityStates: Explicit homeActivityApi v1 capability gate; unsupported, collection mismatch, empty, page failure and object-scoped mutation failure are distinct. Independent list results remain visible; unconfirmed favorite states disable writes.
homeScope.data: Real authorized data in real mode; explicit memory-only demo labels synthetic values. No annotation sequence/view/draft recovery.
homeScope.coverage: Current fill and archive tick share the same existing snapshot. Tick only when archive exists. Pending uses server pendingArchive flag, not unequal counts. Zero/error/stale/archive-error states stay distinct.
homeScope.queries: Separate work/library memory-only queries restore through verified same-identity one-shot team-return memory; never query URL/history/storage.
homeScope.assets: Existing brand SVG, locked local Inter dependency and system CJK fonts; no new raster or outside assets.
homeScope.verification: The local refinement was checked with TypeScript, 373 unit tests, 153 browser tests and a 29-test clean-artifact confirmation. Browser fixtures are synthetic protocol evidence, not live backend, authorization or clinical acceptance. See docs/ui/portal-home-refinement-2026-11-06.zh-CN.md for scope and integration limits.

narrative.overview: The unified Portal retains cold-white planes, near-black text, lake-blue shared defaults and its original local connecting mark. The user adopted Research Desk A for personal home on 2026-11-06. Its local expression, Research handoff desk, leads with continuation, aligned objects and quieter references. Home-specific roles describe scoped overrides, not replacements for shared team/login defaults.
keyCharacteristics: Independent personal and team library semantics
Light navigation and a shared connecting mark
dos: Do preserve the real/demo boundary, fresh CSRF and identity checks.
Do distinguish empty, unavailable, signed-out, expired and lost-access states.
Do keep real team libraries separate from personal sharing.
donts: Don't imply real-time brush collaboration, saving, review progress or viewer loading merely from a rendered button.
Don't replace clinical or protocol verification with UI screenshots.
